title: An improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command vulnerability in the VPN API in Synology…
description: CVE-2026-75785 is a vulnerability in the VPN API of Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before versions 7.3.2-86009-5 and 7.4.1-90080-1. It involves improper neutralization of special elements used in OS commands, allowing remote authenticated administrators to read or write arbitrary files and perform denial-of-service attacks.
